Reminders cannot run while powered off or force stopped. A restart before first unlock uses a neutral 48-hour cache; after that window, reminders need an unlock. Before unlocking, a timezone change cannot recalculate the cached local schedule.

HRT Log\'s features were modelled on Trans Memo, made by the Chrysalide association (its screenshots were used as a reference during development), and on Transmtf HRT Tracker. HRT Log does not use any Trans Memo code and has no affiliation or partnership with Chrysalide or Transmtf.

The concentration models and the lab calibration were written for HRT Log from published studies. Each curve shows on the concentration page which parameters it uses and which studies they were fitted to. Versions up to 0.2.0 used a port of another app\'s model whose reuse permission was unclear; that code has been removed.
Where the concentration model comes from
Sublingual data cover only 8 hours after a dose; later values are extrapolated.
